The '''Storm series''' was a line of [[Cloud car/Legends|cloud cars]] produced by [[Bespin Motors/Legends|Bespin Motors]]. The Storm series was a popular line on the market, and included the [[Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car/Legends|Storm IV Twin-Pod cloud car]].<ref name="RPG-Core">''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game Core Rulebook]]''</ref>
